## Clinical Delivery — Clinical Operations

### Sites and coverage

HealthCore operates three UK clinics: two in London (uk-lon-001, uk-lon-002) and one in Manchester (uk-man-001). We propose a referral partnership with the London satellite clinic closest to Thames Valley University’s main campus. This clinic will provide specialist care access for 3,000 students. The exact clinic (uk-lon-001 or uk-lon-002) depends on travel time and capacity. We will confirm the location once we receive the university’s address and preferred travel distance.

### Staffing and capacity

We will assign a referral coordinator and a registered nurse to manage student referrals. The coordinator handles scheduling, escalations, and communication. The nurse triages referrals and ensures timely access. Staff hours and coverage depend on expected referral volume. We do not assume current capacity. We must confirm available slots at the chosen clinic before committing to a staffing plan.

### Clinical services

The referral network will follow HealthCore’s standard internal referral process. A primary care provider creates a referral in our system. The system routes it to the nearest available specialist clinic. The student receives appointment options. The target turnaround time is 11 days from referral creation to confirmed appointment. If a student does not receive options within 5 business days, the coordinator escalates to Dr. Marcus Reid. This process applies only to in-network specialists. Out-of-network referrals require manual handling and may take longer.

### Open questions

- What is the expected volume of referrals per month (e.g., number of students needing specialist care)?
- Which specialist types are most needed (e.g., mental health, dermatology, orthopedics)?
- What are the desired operating hours and days for the referral clinic?
- What is the current capacity and availability of the satellite clinic(s) near the university?
- Is there a budget for additional staffing or clinic expansion?
- What is the exact distance or travel time from campus to the proposed clinic?
- What is the university’s main campus address?

## Data Protection and Compliance — Compliance and Data Governance

### Regulatory framework
We will comply with UK GDPR for Thames Valley University. Student health data is special category data under Article 9. We will define a lawful basis. We will conduct a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA). We will apply data minimization and purpose limitation. We will set retention periods. The client receives only aggregate, de-identified reports. No individual health records are shared.

### Data Processing Agreement (DPA) under UK GDPR
Our proposal includes a full DPA under Article 28. The DPA covers processing instructions, data subject rights, breach notification, and sub-processor management. We will confirm client’s Data Protection Officer. We will ensure all sub-processors meet UK GDPR standards. Breaches will be reported to the ICO within 72 hours. Pricing is quoted in GBP for this UK contract.

### Compliance approval
Compliance and Data Governance (Claire Whitfield) must approve this proposal before signing. Approval is mandatory. No deviation is allowed. We will coordinate internal procedures with Claire Whitfield prior to final submission.

### Open questions
- What specific categories of student health data will be processed?
- What are the exact processing purposes and lawful basis under UK GDPR?
- Will any third-party sub-processors be involved? If so, what are their details?
- What is the exact deadline for the proposal? We noted “around August 28th” but need a precise date.

## Data Protection and Compliance — Compliance and Data Governance

### Regulatory framework
We will comply with UK GDPR for Thames Valley University. Student health data is special category data under Article 9. We will define a lawful basis. We will conduct a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA). We will apply data minimization and purpose limitation. We will set retention periods. The client receives only aggregate, de-identified reports. No individual health records are shared.

### Data Processing Agreement (DPA) under UK GDPR
Our proposal includes a full DPA under Article 28. The DPA covers processing instructions, data subject rights, breach notification, and sub-processor management. We will confirm client’s Data Protection Officer. We will ensure all sub-processors meet UK GDPR standards. Breaches will be reported to the ICO within 72 hours. Pricing is quoted in GBP for this UK contract.

### Compliance approval
Compliance and Data Governance (Claire Whitfield) must approve this proposal before signing. Approval is mandatory. No deviation is allowed. We will coordinate internal procedures with Claire Whitfield prior to final submission.

### Open questions
- What specific categories of student health data will be processed?
- What are the exact processing purposes and lawful basis under UK GDPR?
- Will any third-party sub-processors be involved? If so, what are their details?
- What is the exact deadline for the proposal? We noted “around August 28th” but need a precise date.
